turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you explain backgammon really simply? I've got a board from my uncle.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure. Each player has fifteen checkers. You roll two dice and move your checkers around the board toward your home corner.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Once all your checkers are home, you start taking them off the board. First to remove all fifteen wins.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: What's the hitting thing? My uncle always shouted when he hit me.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: If one of your checkers is alone on a point and the other player lands there, it's sent to the start and has to come back in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ah, so that's why he was always so pleased.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Exactly. Keep your checkers in pairs where you can, then they're safe. That alone will annoy your uncle a lot.
